p: God giveth him not power to: He shows that it is the plague of God when the rich man does not have a liberal heart to use his riches.
filled with good: If he can never have enough.

burial: As we see often that the covetous man either falls into crimes that deserve death, or is murdered or drowned or hangs himself or such like and so lacks the honour of burial, which is the last office of humanity.
he cometh with vanity: Meaning, the untimely fruit whose life neither profited nor hurt any.
appetite is not filled: His desire and affection.
sight of the eyes than the: To be content with that which God has given is better than to follow the desires that can never be satisfied.
mightier than he: Meaning, God who will make him feel that he is mortal.
good for man in this life: There is no state in which man can live to have perfect quietness in this life.
